title: Runtime agent roster (supervisor + numbered agents)
summary: A supervisor and eight numbered agent charters (gatekeeper, lead, backend, testing, analyst, UI, auditor, context) with a single-writer queue and a bounded spawn, as templates.
why: When a project is itself an agent system that runs unattended, each agent needs one charter and one write area, one owner of state, and bounded runs; most users never need this, so all of it stays off.

items.title: Runtime agent supervisor (orchestrator daemon)
items.does: Adds a supervisor charter and skeleton: one process that owns runtime state, refreshes a heartbeat lock, reconciles stale tasks every 5 minutes and dispatches ready tasks to numbered agents.
items.why: An app with long-running analysis needs agents that keep working while no Claude session is open, and that only works safely with one owner of state.
items.notes: Enable later: when the project itself is an agent system that must keep working unattended.

items.title: Runtime agent 0: gatekeeper
items.does: Adds the charter for agent 0, a deterministic policy gate that accepts or rejects routed tasks against fixed criteria, with no model call; the charter fixes role, write-list, what it never touches, trigger, model, order and output.
items.why: Each agent owns one write area and one charter, so unattended work stays inside a declared scope and a reviewer can see who may change what.
items.notes: Enable later: together with the runtime supervisor, when this agent's role exists in your app.

items.title: Runtime agent 1: lead
items.does: Adds the charter for agent 1, the only writer of the task queue, routing each task to approval, the gatekeeper or ready; the charter fixes role, write-list, what it never touches, trigger, model, order and output.

items.title: Ephemeral agent spawn with charter, budget and timeout
items.does: Adds runtime/spawn.py, which runs one agent task through the profile's headless spawn helper with its charter, an explicit tool list, no session persistence, a timeout, and provider auth variables stripped.
items.why: Unbounded agent runs and a stray key in the environment once broke every spawn, and logs piled up by the thousand; going through the helper puts route, budget and usage logging on every run. It never passes a skip-permissions flag.
items.notes: Enable later: together with the runtime supervisor, once agents need to run without you.

items.title: Single-writer append-only task queue with category gates
items.does: Adds runtime/task_queue.py: an append-only queue written by the lead alone under a lock, with hard-gate, policy-gate and ready categories, retry once then dead-letter, and rotation past a size cap.
items.why: Two writers to one queue lost tasks, and a queue with no cap grew without limit; one writer, a lock and a rotation fix both.
items.notes: Enable later: together with the runtime supervisor, as its queue.

items.title: Unattended agents propose, never apply, on protected files
items.does: Adds a rule and a proposals folder: unattended agents change frozen files and prompts only by writing a proposal that you apply yourself.
items.why: Unattended edits to frozen files bypass review; a proposal keeps the change visible and the decision yours.
items.notes: Enable later: together with the runtime supervisor, before any agent runs unattended.
